identity.title: Native local FIG editable object/property import contribution

specification_anchor_refs.verbatim: [STU-IO-186] NATIVE EDITABILITY SCOPE. Native editable INDD, PRPROJ, AEP and local FIG imports remain explicit requested scope in addition to existing interchange rows; INDD binary import is not satisfied by IDML, PRPROJ/AEP are not satisfied by rendered media, and FIG is not satisfied by SVG or preview extraction. Every format MUST report supported version and per-object/property editable mapping, preserved opaque data, unsupported/loss decisions, provenance and round-trip disposition. Missing decoders/fixtures are blocking scope gaps, never silent exclusions. Parser success, self-render or original-byte preservation is not editable-parity proof.
